rows.v: 写作部分完成1篇英语短文，作答时间为30分钟。
写作占全卷15%。这是卷面权重，不是作文的固定报道分。
rows.src: C1 CET笔试；C3 分数解释（sources.id=c1、c3）

rows.v: 写作按总体印象评分，最高15分。切题、清楚、连贯和语言四方面合起来看，不分别计分。
报道总分最高710分，不设及格线。原始成绩经等值和常模转换形成报道分数。

cards.title: 题型
rows: 依据提纲、情境、图画或图表提示组织短文。
Explain a benefit of keeping a reading journal and illustrate it with an example.

cards.title: 总体评分
rows: 内容切合题意，围绕任务展开。
语言错误较多，部分属于严重错误。

body.p: 总体评分看整篇的表现。一个句子写得准确，整篇不一定进高档。出现一个错误，也不按固定分值扣分。

body.box:
Task: Explain how a reading journal supports learning.
Clear development: A reading journal makes gaps in understanding visible. After summarizing a chapter, a student can identify a missing link and reread the relevant passage.
Unclear development: Journal helps reading. It is many good because the things, and student not know it is.

body.p: Clear development 一段围绕 gaps in understanding 展开，第二句写出具体过程。Unclear development 一段里 the things 和 it 指代不清，句子结构也有多处错误。两个片段只说明评分看什么，不对应具体分数。

body.box: Paper weight: 15%. Holistic writing scale: up to 15. Reported total: up to 710, with no pass line.

body.p: 卷面权重、作文评分量表和报道总分是三个不同的数。15%是卷面权重，不换算成105或106个固定的报道分。课程小测的通过率也不是考试的及格线。

items.stem: Which plan meets the stated writing time and minimum length?
options: One essay of at least 120 words in 30 minutes.
One essay of at least 30 words in 120 minutes.
One essay of at least 120 words in 15 minutes.
One essay of at least 15 words in 30 minutes.
items.why: 概述写明1篇、30分钟、不少于120词，即第一项。

items.stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes writing weight from its holistic scale?
options: Writing has a 15-point reported total and a 710-point holistic scale.
Writing has a 30% paper weight and a 15-point holistic scale.
Writing has a 15% paper weight and a 15-point holistic scale.
Writing has a 15-point paper weight and a 30-point holistic scale.
items.why: 写作占全卷15%，评分量表最高15分，即第三项。

items.stem: Which statement about the reported total is supported by the overview?
options: Its maximum is 710, with a pass line set by the writing scale.
Its maximum is 710, and no pass line is set.
Its maximum is 120, and no pass line is set.
Its maximum is 710, with a pass line of 15%.
items.why: 报道总分最高710分，不设及格线，即第二项。

items.stem: Which response belongs to the writing task described in the lesson?
options: A completed outline replacing the required English essay.
A chart description replacing all written English content.
A set of selected answers replacing an English composition.
An English composition developed from the supplied prompt.
items.why: 题型表写明依据提示写一篇英语短文，即第四项。提纲和图表是提示的形式，不是作答的形式。

items.stem: Which whole-essay description matches the 13–15 band?
options: Relevant content with unclear stretches and frequent serious errors.
Relevant content with clear, coherent development and very few errors.
Clear sentences with frequent serious errors and unclear development.
A relevant opening with unclear meaning throughout the remaining essay.
items.why: 13–15分档的作文切题、表达清楚、连贯，语言错误很少，即第二项。

items.stem: Which whole-essay description matches the 7–9 band rather than the top band?
options: Meaning is clear throughout and errors are almost absent.
Development is coherent throughout and language is nearly error-free.
Meaning is unclear in places and errors are frequent, sometimes serious.
Content is relevant throughout and its meaning remains consistently clear.
items.why: 7–9分档有些地方表达不清，语言错误较多，其中有一些是严重错误，即第三项。
